candidates.name: HM Land Registry plans
verified_facts: HM Land Registry's plans guidance links the current Practice Guide 40 plan, boundary and title-plan sections.
It distinguishes plan preparation, boundaries, title plans and surveying specifications as separate guidance topics.
semantic_limits: A guidance index does not establish the exact parcel boundary, terrain sample, survey epoch or elevation accuracy for a numeric result.

candidates.name: Practice guide 40 supplement 3 - boundaries
verified_facts: The guide states that a legal boundary is an exact line but is rarely identified with precision on the ground or in conveyances and is not shown on Ordnance Survey mapping.
It states that survey and mapping representations operate within defined tolerances.
semantic_limits: A general title-plan boundary or mapped physical feature cannot be treated as the exact legal boundary without determined-boundary or equivalent evidence.
